article.detail:
10月31日發布的STB企劃介紹四集《The Great Indian Family Holiday: Singapore Edition》，由印度藝人家庭遊新加坡，於JioHotstar獨家播放。

四個家庭分別呈現跨代、親子、冒險與美食等旅遊情境。

STB與Cleartrip合作，提供受節目行程啟發的旅遊套票。

旅遊品牌可透過具體的家庭出遊故事呈現目的地特色，再配合相關旅遊套票，方便觀眾由觀看內容走到預訂。

為一個客群選定主題行程，令影片、落地頁及預訂選項互相對應。

本案例根據發布材料及媒體報道整理，尚未取得可核實的節目播放量或新增預訂數據，亦無資料顯示節目使用 AI 製作。
article.detail_en:
STB’s October 31 campaign release describes a four-episode Singapore family-travel series featuring Indian celebrities, streaming exclusively on JioHotstar.

Four families present intergenerational, parent-child, adventure and food-led travel situations.

STB partners with Cleartrip on holiday packages inspired by the series.

Destination content can connect specific family situations to bookable products.

Match one audience-specific itinerary across video, landing page and booking options.

This is a release-based campaign case, without verified viewing or incremental-booking results; no AI production is claimed.
